canonicalization.array_order: preserved; state entity collections are sorted before hashing as specified in sync-protocol.md
canonicalization.entry_hash: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the complete log entry excluding entry_hash
canonicalization.number_format: JSON integers only in hash-bearing vectors; no NaN or Infinity
canonicalization.object_keys: sorted lexicographically by Unicode code point
canonicalization.request_hash: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON for store_id, device_id, operation_id, operation_type, base_version, and payload
canonicalization.state_hash: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the replayed_state object
canonicalization.whitespace: no insignificant whitespace (JSON separators comma and colon)

description: Synthetic P-02 protocol vectors for P-05 and P-07. No production credentials or customer data.

harness_contract.act: Execute input.steps in array order. Fields named action select the protocol operation; commit and response_delivered control fault injection where present.
harness_contract.arrange: Load input.given exactly with the supplied fixed IDs and clocks.
harness_contract.assert: Compare expected_output as the exact logical result projection. Transport headers and timing outside the supplied clocks are not compared.
harness_contract.hash_verification: Recompute request_hash, entry_hash, and state_hash using canonicalization; never replace a supplied expected hash with an implementation-generated value before comparison.
harness_contract.security: All proofs, signatures, nonces, keys, and phone values are synthetic fixtures and must never be accepted by production configuration.

vectors.scenario: Owner creates a single-use companion pairing QR with the conservative five-minute expiry.
Companion consumes a valid owner-created QR and receives an active device pairing and session.
Expired pairing QR fails closed without creating a device or session.
Single-use QR replay cannot pair another device.
An active paired device resumes with a new session without changing operation identity.
Device revocation invalidates its session, releases its lock as a disconnect, and blocks later mutations.
Valid mutation is durably accepted once with OCC, response, domain effect, and outbox entry in one Hub transaction.
Exact operation replay returns the original response without a new version or outbox entry.
Stale base_version returns an explicit conflict and no product effect while preserving the rejected operation result.
Reusing operation_id with changed payload is a hard conflict and does not replace the original result.
Draft creation atomically acquires a normalized-phone lock with the 300-second default.
A second device receives a hard conflict for the same normalized phone and consumes no invoice number.
The lock-owning device exact replay follows idempotency rather than producing a lock conflict.
Issue releases the phone lock and a second device can make a sequential purchase immediately.
Hub-time inactivity expires the default lock at exactly 300 seconds and retires the abandoned draft.
Hub-observed disconnect releases the lock and a late owner write cannot regain ownership.
Hub-off behavior blocks new companion work without creating authoritative local state.
Contiguous ascending log batch is ingested atomically and advances the store high watermark.
Duplicate delivery of an already ingested batch is acknowledged without new entries or projections.
A gap fails closed and reports the first missing operation sequence.
Out-of-order entries inside a batch are rejected without partial ingest.
Retry after a lost commit response is idempotent and does not duplicate the log.
Cloud backpressure retains the durable outbox and returns retry and batch limits.
Entry content whose hash does not match is rejected and quarantined for review.
A previous writer epoch is fenced and its divergent unsynced entries are not merged automatically.
SMS OTP alone cannot export or activate a restored store.
OTP plus recovery-key proof permits restore, and a matching replayed-state hash activates the new writer.
OTP plus approval from a previously paired device authorizes the restore manifest before replay.
A replayed-state hash mismatch aborts restore before writer activation.
Disk loss restores only the cloud high watermark and explicitly reports unrecoverable unsynced operations.
Normal activation of a second Hub for one store is rejected before it can accept writes.
Companion clock skew cannot change Hub lock expiry or operation ordering.
WAN partition does not stop Hub-mediated LAN work; durable entries synchronize once after healing.
Partial batch delivery does not apply a partial projection and a complete retry succeeds once.
